summary: Participant shares, payer claims and settlements for a particular group.

targets.utterance: Set up a shared expenses group for our trip.
targets.distinguish: Confirm the participant roster. A trip itinerary does not imply permission to share financial records.

targets.utterance: Split this dinner bill with my travel group.
targets.distinguish: Resolve the group, payer, currency and intended shares. Link the receipt separately.

targets.utterance: Record that Sam paid me their share today.
targets.distinguish: Select group and parties. A proposed transfer is not evidence of a completed settlement.
